title: Technology Sector Update for 07/30/2018: PRKR,ON,CYOU
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT -1.92%
AAPL -0.50%
IBM -0.04%
CSCO -0.39%
GOOG -1.53%
Technology stocks were getting rocked again to begin the new week, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 index falling almost 1.9% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor index was sliding more than 1.1% lower in recent trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ ParkerVision ( PRKR ) climbed over 4% on Monday after the radio-frequency technology company announced a $2 million securities purchase agreement with Aspire Capital Fund LLC. Under terms of the agreement, the company will receive $975,000 upfront and is slated to receive the balance after a registration statement for the transaction is declared effective by the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
In other sector news:
- ON Semiconductor ( ON ) was trading near its session low Monday afternoon, dropping almost 7%, despite reporting Q2 net income and revenue topping analyst estimates. The semiconductor components manufacturer also sees Q3 sales in-line to above Street view.
- Changyou.com ( CYOU ) dropped to an all-time low on Monday, sinking over 15% to a worst-ever $12.68 a share after the mobile gaming platform reported Q2 revenue missing the Capital IQ consensus and upstaging better-than-expected net income for the April-to-June reporting period. It also guided Q3 sales lagging the Street view.
